notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 1533 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Gd; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.935$ kcal/mol. 1585 K, melting point of Gd; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.403$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 8.875 + 0.036 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.608 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 8.875 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.018 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 0.608 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 2.852$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-1533 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 19.473 + 1.918 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 2.345 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 449.750 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 19.473 - 1.918 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 2.345 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 224.875 \text{T}^{-1} - 5.753 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1533-1585 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 19.832 - 2.124 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.142 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 26.650 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 19.832 + 2.124 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.142 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 13.325 \text{T}^{-1} - 32.160 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1585-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 20.683 - 4.177 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.142 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 26.650 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 20.683 + 4.177 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.142 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 13.325 \text{T}^{-1} - 47.824 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K based on Fries (42). Other data are those estimated by Mills (80).
